title: Saving documents in Draft Mode
text:
Saving documents in Draft Mode 
 N avigation in Farvision 
 Saving documents 
 in draft mode 
 Draft 
 mode allows users to temporarily save typed data without storing the data 
 in the actual transactional database. Large 
 transactions can be saved in interim state as Draft mode for future use. 
 User can resume re-entry of transactions from draft mode. 
 Transactions within 
 draft mode are not available for any further subsequent processing. Draft Mode has to be set 
 as ‘ON’ in the interface for Draft mode saving button to be enabled. There 
 is no such setting required for Draft mode enabling. It is enabled by 
 code only. 
 ‘Save 
 As Draft’ is enabled under submit menu. 
 After 
 a document is saved as draft, user can only retrieve it again after making 
 draft mode on in the same interface. 
 Click 
 on the row to open the screen and make further entry or necessary changes. 
 After that user is required to finally submit and save the entry. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Queue Management for Reports
text:
Queue Management for Reports 
 Some common features of Farvision 
 Queue Management for Reports 
 Queue management allows for processing of data in the background so that the user does not have to wait while data is being processed. Once the report or process is completed a notification will be provided that the job has been completed. It is important to use queues so that server utilization is not disturbed during peak working hours. 
 There are two types of queues 
 Queue Reports 
 Queue Processes 
 Notifications 
 Desktop notification will be shown after completion of job. Report can be downloaded from the notification alert. Queue Reports 
Some reports and bulk print format can be queued. There are two types of processes 
 ● Fire and forget - the queue is started on demand when the report has to be processed 
 ● Repeat every few minutes - any data which is added for the bulk processing will be processed, and checking for new data will be done on a predefined frequency. 
 Fire and forget 
 A job id is assigned against reports which are being queued under fire and forget. A notification will be sent to the user’s device once the report is ready. Reports which have been queued can only be printed from the Queue management console. Queued reports cannot be printed (either PDF or Excel) from the menu interface from which generation of report was started. 
 Example : Application detail register, Booking register, Invoice register and Receipt register, Indent register, Purchase order register, Goods receipt Note register and Purchase Bill register. Examples for Bulk Printing of documents are Invoice, Booking annexure, Applicant Ledger. 
 Repeat every few minutes 
Queues which repeat every few minutes are used for bulk printing of documents. No job id assigned as it is a continuous loop where more documents which are added for bulk processes are picked up. After receiving the notification, search Bulk Printing in the menu column and then for the relevant menu Item. 
 Download : Once the report is complete, it can be downloaded and saved locally. The report will be automatically deleted after downloading. Reports will be visible in the queue console until the reports are downloaded. Users are allowed to download their reports while admin users can download report of any user. 
 Delete : Pending and generated report can be deleted. If the status is pending, the delete button will stop the processing of the report. If the status is Complete, delete will physically remove the report and it will not be available, it is deleted from the server. 
 Status : Pending, In Process, Complete, Error, No record found are the status of the queued report. 
 Remarks : This column provides details of the status. Example, For In process, it will show start. 
 Desktop notification will be shown after completion of the job. Hide Downloaded : On select of the Hide Downloaded check box, all downloaded row items will be hidden and only those row items will be shown which are pending for download. Queue Process 
 Some reports a process has to be run before the report can be generated. 
 Example : Finance module cash flow report generated through process method and process report will be downloaded from queue console under the Process tab. 
 Property management invoice generated through bulk invoice menu after notification will be downloaded from the queue console. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Data Import Process
text:
Data Import Process 
 Some common features of Farvision 
 Data Import Process 
 Data import allows data to be imported from excel sheets instead of entering through the interface. Data has to be entered in pre-defined excel sheets, checked for correctness and is then imported into Farvision. Data import is available for many masters and a few transactions, the process of importing is the same. Only the excel template is different in which data has to be entered. 
 Data import is normally used by first time users of Farvision, or if there is a huge volume. Bulk data can be inserted into Farvision and it saves time. Once your backlog is cleared, it is recommended to use the interface for day to day entry. Sometimes data import is also used where the number of rows in a document is very large, example a journal voucher with 200 lines. 
 There are four steps to be followed 
 ● Download Template 
 ● Upload Template 
 ● Validate Data 
 ● Import Data 
 DOWNLOAD TEMPLATE 
 Object: This is the master or transaction form for which the excel template has to be downloaded. 
 Nested Objects: Some forms which have to be imported have a lot of data, and have multiple excel worksheets in one excel template. These multiple worksheets normally correspond to tabs of the entry interface. Example, Account Head Import will have the worksheets for Ledger, Ledger Address, Ledger Communication, Ledger Contact, Bank Details, etc. 
 All these worksheets are linked to each other through a common field called Link Ref Code . The same value of this field in each row has to be entered under ImportLinkRefCode in the nested worksheets. In the Ledger worksheet Link Ref Code ‘1’ has details of Amar Singh, Link Ref Code ‘2’ has details of Amit Kumar Pal. In the Ledger Address worksheet, ImportLinkRefCode ‘1’ will contain address details of Amar Singh, Link Ref Code ‘2’ will contain address details of Amit Kumar Pal. The value given to the Link Ref Code and ImportLinkRefCode has to be the same so that data in the different worksheets can be associated with each other. 
 Download template : Download the template by clicking the Download button. An excel file will be downloaded on your local computer. Open the excel sheet. Enter the data in the excel sheet. 
 About the Excel Template 
 There may be one or more worksheets in which data has to or can be entered. Click on the different worksheets to enter data in them. Remember to use the same identifying value in all worksheets so that data between the different worksheets can be linked to each other. In case there is no data to be filled in the nested worksheets, leave it blank. Do not fill only the ImportLinkRefCode if no other data is available for entry in that sheet. In case there is a row in the main sheet but there is no associated data for that row in the linked sheets, skip that row number in the linked sheet. 
 Each excel template has an Info worksheet which will guide the user about the properties of the fields. 
 Sheet Name : Worksheet names are listed here. 
 Column Names : Fields available in all associated worksheets are listed here. Data has to be entered as rows, fields are the columns. 
 Properties : Fields can have the following properties 
 Is required: True - this is a mandatory field, has to be entered. 
 Is required: False - this is an optional field. 
 Max length: The maximum number of characters which can be entered in that field. 
 The following points have to be kept in mind while filling data in the prescribed excel sheet 
 Do not remove any columns or worksheets , even if there is no data to be entered in them. Format must be as per the original excel template downloaded. 
 Do not change any names, settings, alignment, formatting of fields, worksheet, or files . 
 Remove any hyperlinks from the data fields . Example Email. 
 Try to import records into batches of 100, 200 or 500 rows at a time. Import can be run multiple times. Data will keep on getting added in Farvision. 
 Fill all mandatory fields 
 Enter data in ImportLinkRefCode if data is there in the associated worksheets 
 Do not enter blank rows , especially at the end of the excel sheet 
 Wherever applicable, Debit and Credit amounts should tally . 
 Spelling of account heads, parent account, items, etc should be correct, i.e. match with the masters in Farvision 
 Wherever applicable, data in related sheets should tally with the data in the main sheet . Example, Receipt/Payment or Journals, the Adjustment Info amount for each party should tally with the amount in Ledger details for the same party. 
 Some tips 
 Clear cache and clear history of the browser, in case of unknown error 
 UPLOAD TEMPLATE 
 Upload the filled out excel Template to start the data uploading process. 
 Select File : Select the file in which data has been entered and has to be uploaded. 
 The template can be dragged and dropped or the same can be selected from its location. Click on the Drop files to upload panel. Select the file in which data has been entered and has to be uploaded. Click on the Upload button. Once the template has been uploaded, it will show the message Uploaded Successfully. Click on Next button to go to the data validation step. VALIDATE DATA Once the filled up excel has been uploaded, the data has to be validated from the template and click on Next 
 Process Queue : Click on the box so that the validation process can be routed through the Queue Management console. If the data volume is large, it is important to queue this process else the server will become very slow. 
 Validate Data : Click on the Start Validation button to start the validation process. 
 Status : While the data validation is ongoing, a status bar will show Validating Data, Please Wait. If the data validation is successful, it will show the status as Success. If data is not correct and has failed the validation process, it will show Error Found. 
 Result : In case the status is not successful, the reasons why validation has failed will be provided in this Excel file which can be downloaded. The file will have both data which has a problem and data which is correct. The data where there is a problem is highlighted in yellow. The problems with the data will be displayed in the Import Remarks column. In this example, HSN Id does not exist for Construction service in HSN Master. 
 In this example, Relationship should have Son or Wife, and the name Rakesh Kumar and Mahaveer Singh should have been entered in Relative Name respectively. 
 In this example, Postal code is a mandatory field that can’t be blank. 
 The validation routine has to be run repeatedly till there are no errors left. 
 Click on the Next button to go to the Import Data tab. 
 IMPORT DATA 
 Click on Start Import to start importing data from filled up excel template file into Farvision. On successful import, it will show the status as Success. Click on the Finish button. Data which has been imported can be checked in the respective Advanced Search for the transaction or master forms. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Getting Started with SFA
text:
Lead vs Opportunity 
 Overview 
 of SFA: Lead vs Opportunity 
 Enquiry classification 
 into Leads and Opportunities 
 Key 
 Concepts 
 1. 
 Normally leads are handled by the marketing team as their job 
 is to qualify the enquiries 
 2. 
 Opportunities are handled by the sales team whose job is to qualify 
 the opportunity 
 3. 
 In case the same person is handling both the lead and the opportunity 
 it is possible to convert the lead into an opportunity at the 
 time of saving the lead itself 
 4. 
 Another key difference is that a Lead is converted to a Contact 
 or an Account and against each Contact there can be multiple Opportunities. 
 (we shall explain more about this concept later in the training) 
 5. 
 Further Leads are not won or lost, they lie as unqualified leads 
 or are converted to Opportunities. Meanwhile, it is opportunities 
 which are won or lost 
 6. 
 Hence The many benefits of keeping Enquiries in 2 buckets of Leads 
 and Opportunities are: 
 a. 
 There may be two teams managing enquiries, a Telecalling team 
 member and a Sales team member managing the same enquiry 
 b. 
 One Lead can result in multiple opportunities over time. From 
 here we will be able to track this analysis as well 
 c. 
 Since most of the enquiries do not qualify, it is easier to see 
 a focused list of valid enquiries (opportunities) 
 Not 
 advisable but can be done if desired. 
 7. 
 In case one doesn’t want to maintain separate Leads and Opportunities, 
 then one can maintain just Leads and avoid converting to Opportunities. 
 Last 
 Modified on 04-02-2020 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Qualifying Leads and Opportunities
text:
Qualifying Leads and Opportunities 
 Getting Started with SFA" />
 Overview 
 of SFA: Qualifying 
 Leads and Opportunities 
 Enquiry Qualification 
 Q ualification 
 can be done for both Leads and Opportunities 
 The 
 different categories of disposition of a Lead is called “Status” 
 The 
 different stages of maturity of an Opportunity is called a “Stage” 
 This 
 helps to filter Enquiries by their “Status” or their “Stage” so 
 that we can more easily focus on which Enquiries to focus on.

 Email Configuration 
Email configuration setup is done through this interface. Email can be configured to send through free mailing service like gmail, yahoo etc. and through paid email service like sendgrid. After email configuration user is required to create Email Template and setup Communication Rule

 STEP1 
 A) Create email configuration if client site has its own SMTP setup. But do not delete Farvision default configuration from email configuration menu 
 B) If Farvision default configuration is not to be used then make the default checkbox unchecked 
 C) PORT NUMBER: Use the Gmail SMTP Server. If you connect using SSL or TLS, you can send mail to anyone with smtp.gmail.com. Connect to smtp.gmail.com on port 465, if you're using SSL. (Connect on port 587 if you're using TLS.) 
 STEP2 
 Application server must have the required setup for windows task scheduler for Farvision communication file r2 (fvcomr2email). Make sure from systems department. 
 STEP3 
 In local machine enable ‘less secure app’ from Gmail security setting if test mail does not go. 
 STEP4 
 Make sure from release team fvcom patches are updated in server. 
 STEP5 
 If mail does not go immediately in control s server, wait for sometime. SMTP port may not be open in datacenter. Contact system department and confirm. 
 For gmail server, mail sending app server requires to open SMTP PORT 465 and 587 for outbound. 
 Steps to open SMTP PORT 465 and 587 
 Type the said command at application server command prompt, then below screen will appear it means port is open. 
 Follow same steps for SMTP PORT 587 
 OUTPUT 
 1. Outbox: outbox will contain the unsent mails. There is a resend button on the same page. If unsent mail is selected and resend button is clicked then mail will be sent if all other conditions are fulfilled. 
 2. Email history : Test mails from email configuration and mails sent manually will be shown in email history. For example, from advance search window of Money receipt (sales and customer care), if documents are selected and sent mail then it will be visible in history. 
 3. Email register : All auto mails / Bulk mails sent from modules will be visible in email register. If email register is not visible then get the menu right from user right menu. 
 POP/SMTP Settings in Gmail 
 Under 'Forwarding and POP/IMAP' tab, select the radio button 'Enable POP for mail that arrives from now on ' .Then click on 'Configuration Instructions' to check.

 Following points to be kept in mind while configuring email:

 Once the mail is sent successfully the user can configure the email with the details given by the provider. 
 Task Scheduler Configuration for sending email 
 Open Task Scheduler 
 Create Basic Task 
 Provide Name and click ‘Next’ 
 Under ‘Trigger’ menu select the required option to start the task and click ‘Next’ 
 Select Start Date & Time of the task and click ‘Next’ 
 Select the action as ‘Start a program’ and click ‘Next’ 
 Browse & Select File “FvComR2Email.exe” and click ‘Open’. 
 Click ‘Next’ 
 Select the checkbox “Open the Properties dialog for this task when I click Finish” & click ‘Finish’ 
 Go to Settings and change ‘Stop the task if it runs longer than:’ to 1 Hour 
 Go to ‘Triggers’ Tab and click on ‘Edit’ 
 Select the checkboxes as shown below and set ‘Repeat task every:’ to 15 Minutes and click ‘Ok’ 
 Go to General Tab, select the checkboxes as shown below and provide Administrator Password and click ‘Ok’ 
 On successful Run, it will show “The Operation completed successfully“ as shown below 
 Troubleshooting 
 1. smtp.office365.com mail not going 
 Ans: Server port may not be open. Contact system team for ControlS Clients. 
 2. If default is ticked, then email config can not be saved 
 Ans: Remove default from email configuration screen of Farvision ERP. 
 3. When mail not going showing bad credential error 
 Ans: Either password is incorrect in Email configuration or 'Less secure app' is NOT enabled in Chrome advanced settings of the local machine. 
 4. When outbox showing following error ‘Subject: test Error: SMTPX: No connection could be made because the target machine actively refused it.’ 
 Ans: Server port may not be open. Contact system team for Control S server. 
 5. When bulk mail not going from Application 
 Ans: Check in application server task scheduler if ‘FVComR2Email’ is missing or not. Contact System department for Control S (cloud) clients as well as for on premise clients. 
 6. When approval mail not going to recipient and outbox showing messages like - ' Subject : Approval Notification for Document No : SBT/00007/20-21 Error : SMTPX:No recipients found in the message.’ 
 Ans: In login user, Email 1 field is either blank or wrong email id is given

title: Widgets
text:
Widgets 
 Widgets 
 W idgets display often used functions that the user can trigger 
 right from the home screen 
 New 
 Leads : User can see the Lead list as on today 
 Untouched 
 Leads : User can see the Lead for which no Activity is done. D uring change 
 Owner , if user selects the Is 
 Touched option, the lead will be removed from the Untouched 
 Leads. 
 Task 
 Schedule : User can see the list of Task scheduled for today 
 Overdue 
 Tasks : User can see the list of all pending tasks 
 New 
 Opportunity : User can see the Opportunity created as on today 
 Site 
 Visit : User can see the list of Lead for which Site Visit Done 
 today 
 Site 
 Visit Schedule : User can see the list of Lead for which Site Visit 
 Scheduled today 
 Missed 
 Calls: User can see total Missed Call today 
 Lead 
 Converted to Opportunity : User can see the List of Opportunity 
 created from converting the Lead 
 Total 
 Calls: User can see the total number 
 of phone calls 
 Total 
 Talk Time: User can see the total number 
 of talk time 
 Average 
 Call Duration: User can see the average 
 call duration 
 Total Re Enquiry: User can see number 
 of leads which already exist are repeated from another source or revived 
 after some time 
 Untouched 
 Opportunity: If no activity is created 
 for new opportunity it will be shown in Untouched opportunity 
 Direct Opportunity: If the Opportunity 
 created from contact then its count will be shown in Direct Opportunity 
 on Today’s basis 
 Non-Workable Lead: It will show 
 total count of non-workable leads 
 Origin 
 Wise Leads: User can see origin wise 
 total number of leads for example from Walk in, Telephonic, Auto Lead 
 from Any Source and Email 
 Campaign 
 Wise Leads: User can see total number 
 of leads coming from different campaigns 
 Moved 
 Leads: User can see total number of 
 moved leads i.e. those have been assigned to another sales persons 
 Upcoming 
 Tasks: User can see total number of upcoming tasks, perhaps for the next 
 week or next month 
 Lead 
 Profile Scoring: User can see profile 
 scoring of leads based on which lead priority can be assumed 
 Lead 
 Activity Scoring: User can see activity 
 scoring of leads based on which lead priority can be assumed 
 Status Details: User can see the 
 status based on Product wise Number of Leads, Opportunity, Total Count, 
 Number of Booked & Lost.

 Gamut Infosystems Limited

text:

 Account 
 Type 
 Type 
 of account is defined in 'Account Type' interface. 
 Examples 
 Account 
 Type 
 Agent/Broker 
 Customer 
 Employee 
 Prospect 
 Referral 
 Creating Account Type 
 Main Info 
 Code: 
 Enter code name of the account type (Mandatory) 
 Description: 
 Enter description of the account type (Mandatory). Description can be 
 Alpha Numeric but no special character is allowed. 
 There 
 are some generic and system defined Account Types. Examples of such account 
 types can be Agent, Customer, Prospect, Media Agency, Reference etc. 
 Already created 'Account Types' 
 can be searched by their code from 'Code' drop down list as shown below. 
 If any of them matches with the requirement then there is no need to create 
 new. Otherwise new 'Account Type' is to be created as per the requirement 
 of the organization. 
 Change History 
 After creating 
 and saving account type, if there is any modification done then this tab 
 shows history of modification with informations like user, date and time 
 of modification and action taken. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

 UTM Configuration 
 UTM Parameters, 
 known as Google's Urchin Tracking Module, allows sales team to track and 
 measure the success of various dimensions of their online marketing campaigns. 
 UTM 
 is a simple code that can be attached to any URL to generate Google Analytics 
 data for digital campaigns. Specific to Google Analytics, UTM helps track 
 the progress of the campaign on all online platforms. For example, any 
 organization can use UTM variables to track specific links such as the 
 link to their website from their Twitter bio. 
 Through 
 UTM Configuration user is able to generate different URLs of campaigns 
 and track the success through Google Analytics Accounts.

title: Task
text:
Task 
 Help > Lead Management" />
 Tutorial: Creating Task 
 Task 
 Type of communication 
 or offer provided for the lead/opportunity/account/contact is recorded 
 in this task page. Through “ entry type” selection one can select 
 any one option. Now based on this selection task data is inserted. 
 Through Task 
 interface user can create new task. 
 Entry 
 Type : Select entry type from drop down list (Mandatory) 
 Opportunity 
 Tag/Lead Tag/Contact Tag/Account Tag : This will change as per the 
 entry type selection. Select the required from the drop down list 
 Task 
 Type : Select activity type from drop down list. Phone Call, Email, 
 Call Up Prospect etc. are some examples of task type.(Mandatory) (Record comes from Setup > Transaction 
 Type > Activity 
 Type ). 
 Due 
 Date : Enter due date of task with the help of calendar pop up (Mandatory) 
 Time : 
 User is able to set time using clock 
 Task 
 Owner : Select the name of the sales person who is to be allocated 
 to the task (Mandatory). (Record comes 
 from Setup > Sales Team > Sales 
 Person ). 
 Remarks : 
 Enter any remarks on task (Mandatory) 
 Click 'Continue' 
 and 'Save'. 
 Using Lead Master, Opportunity Master, Contact Master 
 and Account Master tab shows details of Lead, Opportunity, Contact and 
 Account details for a particular respectively. 
 Using Activity tag details 
 activity over a lead or an opportunity can be noticed. 
 From Task Advance Search grid , Tasks can be converted to activity 
 and Lead 
 can also be converted into Opportunity. 
 Notes: 
 1. 
 In Task without Lead, non workable Leads are excluded. If created Task 
 is converted into Activity then those Leads are also excluded from the 
 list. 
 2. 
 In Task without Opportunity Booked and Lost Opportunities are excluded. 
 If created Task is converted into Activity then those Opportunities are 
 also excluded from the list. 
 3. 
 Filter options for Product and Campaign Reference are there in Task Advance 
 Search. 
 Task Import 
 Tasks 
 can be imported using a proper Task import template. In this process users 
 have to download the Task template from the given import menu. Then this 
 template has to be filled with proper information. Then upload this template 
 and validate for any error. If it shows success after validation then 
 import this template data in the system using the import button. 
 Tutorial: Creating Task 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

 Tutorial: Conversion of Lead to opportunity 
 Conversion 
 of Lead to Opportunity 
 Lead or prospect 
 can easily be converted into opportunity through the process as explained 
 below. 
 Under the 
 section ‘Lead Status’ in ‘Lead’ interface, click on the row to select 
 the lead. 
 Click the 
 addins icon as indicated with the red arrow and click on ‘Convert’ in 
 the drop down menu as shown below. 
 The following window will open named ‘Convert’ 
 Check 
 'Is Contact', 'Is Account' and 'Is Opportunity' if the conversion needed 
 for all three. 
 Click ‘Save’ 
 button. The content 
 in the ‘Convert’ window gets changed. The new contact name is shown added 
 as marked in the screen below for account, contact and opportunity. 
 Finally click ‘Save’ button and the process to convert 
 the lead into opportunity is now completed. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Contact
text:
Contact 
 Help > Lead Management" />
 Tutorial: Creating Contact 
 Contact 
 Before 
 creating contact, user may require to record the following information 
 Occupation 
 Designation 
 Account 
 Through 
 ‘Contact’ interface details of the key contact person of the company can 
 be updated. 
 Prospect contact details can be searched based 
 on the criteria selected. The criteria includes 'Search by Name', 'Search 
 by Mobile', 'Search by Phone’, ‘Search by Email’, ‘Search by City’ and 
 'Search by State’. 
 Creating Contact 
 Personal Information: 
 Salutation : Select 
 salutation e.g. MR., MRS., DR. etc. 
 Enter 
 ‘ First Name ’ (Mandatory), ‘ Middle Name ’ and ‘ Last Name ’ 
 (Mandatory). 
 Suffix : 
 Enter the suffix code 
 Date 
 Of Birth : Enter date of birth 
 Nationality : 
 Select nationality e.g. Indian, Srilankan, NRI etc. 
 Religion : 
 Select religion e.g. Hinduism, Buddhism, Islam, Christianity etc. 
 Gender : 
 Select gender 
 Address: 
 Address: 
 Provide 
 address (Road Name, locality, landmark) 
 Country : 
 Search and select the name of the country 
 State : 
 Search and select the name of the state 
 City : 
 Search and select the name of the city 
 Postal 
 Code : Enter the postal code 
 Other Address: 
 Check 
 ‘Please check if same’ check box if the other address is same. Provide 
 all the values if other address is different. 
 Communication: 
 Enter 
 mobile number(s) (One mobile number is mandatory) and Land line number. 
 At least one mobile number is mandatory. 
 Check 
 mark ‘SMS not sending’ if required. Otherwise SMS will be sent

 Tutorial: Creating Campaign 
 Campaign 
 Before creating campaign, user needs to record

 Through this 
 interface outbound marketing campaigns with E-mail, SMS, Tele-calling, digital, 
 seminars and other kinds of marketing collateral can be organized. 
 Campaigns 
 usually have one of the following primary goals: 
 Lead generation campaigns include email 
 blasts, web seminars, conferences, and trade shows. These types of campaigns 
 directly generate new prospects. In Sales force, the effectiveness of 
 each campaign can easily be tracked in terms of new business generation. 
There are four sections in the interface 'Information', 'Status', 'Grouping' 
 and 'Planning' 
 Information 
 Campaign: Enter the name of the campaign (Mandatory) 
 Campaign 
 Alias: Enter the brief name of the 
 campaign (Mandatory) 
 Campaign 
 Hierarchy: Select 
 the hierarchy of the campaign (Mandatory). Records are in-built and can 
 be selected from drop down list 
 Campaign Owner: Select 
 the name of the campaign owner. (Record 
 comes from Setup > Sales Team > Sales 
 Person ) 
 Parent: 
 If campaign hierarchy is chosen as child then this field will be active. 
 (Record comes from Setup > 
 Campaign > Campaign 
 Type ) 
 Status 
 Start Date: Enter start date of the campaign 
 End Date: Enter end date of the campaign 
 Active Upto: Enter the 
 date upto which the campaign will be active 
 Status: Select the status of the campaign from drop down list (Mandatory). 
 (Record comes from Setup > Campaign 
 > Campaign 
 Status ) 
 Grouping 
 Campaign Type: Select the type of campaign. For example, print, 
 electronic etc. (Record comes from Setup 
 > Campaign > Campaign 
 Type ) 
 Campaign Sub Type: Select the sub type of campaign. For example 
 if campaign type is 'Print' then 'Newspaper' will be one of the campaign 
 sub types. (Record comes from Setup > 
 Campaign > Campaign 
 Sub Type ) 
 Campaign Reference: 
 Select the campaign reference name. (Record 
 comes from Setup > Campaign > Campaign 
 Reference ) 
 Remarks: Enter remarks 
 on grouping. 
 Planning 
 This section is not mandatory. 
 Budgeted Cost: Enter the budgeted cost of the campaign 
 Actual Cost: Enter the actual cost of the campaign 
 Target Group Size: Enter 
 the target group size number 
 Expected Revenue: Enter the expected revenue figure 
 Expected Lead: Enter 
 the expected number of lead 
 Expected Response (%): Enter the expected response percentage 
 Product: 
 Select product name. (Record comes from Setup > Product > Product ) 
 Campaign Duration : Select campaign 
 duration among short, long and special event as required 
 For 
 any file attachment with campaign data use Attachment tab and then use 
 “Add New Row” Button. 
 From campaign list 
 selecting any required campaign edit, delete etc. are possible. 
 While creating/editing any Campaign, “Lead Master” 
 and “Opportunity Master” appear as individual tab in the header portion. 
 Lead 
 Master: Whatever 
 Leads generated/created tagging this particular campaign will appear here. 
 Opportunity 
 Master: Whatever Opportunities created/generated tagging this particular 
 campaign will appear here.

 Quick Search 
 Through ‘Quick Search’ interface user is 
 able to search and find leads, opportunities, accounts and contacts by 
 typing the respective names and pressing enter key in the keyboard to 
 fetch search result. Further user can do search by name, mobile number, 
 email id and owner name. 
 Search by Id 
 Search by Mobile Number 
 Search by Email ID 
 Above images are the example of search 
 by mobile and email. In the similar style owner, alternative mobile number 
 and alternative email ids are also used for searching purposes in this 
 quick search segment. 
 Now based on this quick search option 
 users can perform the following 
 Edit 
 Task 
 Activity 
 Change Owner 
 Convert Lead to 
 View Activity History 
 Convert Task to Activity 
 Click icon 
 to avail of the following options 
 Edit 
 Edit menu provides editing facility 
 of the searched item based on the area it searched. 
 Task 
 Click on ‘Task’ 
 menu to create task 
 Activity 
 Click on ‘Activity’ 
 menu to create activity or convert the task into activity 
 Change

 this menu to change the Lead or opportunity owner. 
 Convert 
 to lead 
 Click 
 on this menu to convert the lead (if qualified) to ‘Contact’ or ‘Account’ 
 or ‘Opportunity’ 
 Note: Lead

 Global Search if right is not given. If user click on Convert Lead To..or 
 Change Owner option then it opens an alert message. 
 View

 The follow-up

 Convert Task to Opportunity

title: Email Campaign
text:
Email Campaign 
 Help > Lead Automation" />
 Tutorial: Creating Email Campaign 
 Email Campaign 
 An 
 email campaign is a set of individual email messages that are deployed 
 across a specific period of time with one specific purpose such as discount 
 on a product in any occasion may be festive, seasonal etc. Farvision has 
 an in built efficient feature to create, compose and send email to group 
 of leads or opportunities. 
 Click 'New' 
 to create a new email template using basic template or modify an existing 
 template using Email Template. Birthday Template can also be created. 
 Select Template 
 1. 
 Basic Template: It is used to create 
 a new basic template 
 2. 
 Email Template: It is used to modify and use already saved email 
 templates 
 3 . 
 Birthday Template: It is used 
 to create Birthday templates 
 1. Basic Template 
 Click on 
 'Basic Template' to create a new email template 
 Compose Template 
 On clicking 
 'Blank Template', the 'Compose Template' tab section activated. Type mail 
 body text with subject. Click, drag and drop each content from right hand 
 side "Content" column as required from Text, Image, Button, 
 Separator and Social icons to design the template. 
 Click 'Browse' 
 to drop/upload image. 
 Type text 
 as per requirement, and separator, social icons, button can be dragged 
 and dropped. 
 Any existing 
 structure can be deleted by clicking on icon. 
 Structure 
 Any 
 structure can be dragged and dropped from right side panel 
 Using 
 Existing HTML 
 Any 
 existing HTML can be used to create the email template. After clearing 
 all the structures, drag a new blank structure. 
 Copy the 
 HTML code and paste in the blank structure. 
 The HTML 
 template has now been created as shown below 
 Tag Recipients 
 Select entry 
 type to select mail recipients. 
 Scheduler 
 Scheduler 
 is used to schedule the email frequency that contains the options daily, 
 weekly, monthly, hourly and minutely. 
 If 'To Me' option is selected 
 then the email will be fired from the logged in user's email address. 
 If 'To Me 
 and/or Other' option is selected then the emails will be fired from the 
 logged in user's email address along with the selected sales person's 
 or from only selected sales person's email address. 
 Submit and 
 save the template. 
 2. Email Template 
 Click on 
 'Email Template' to modify an existing or saved email template 
 Click on 
 template thumbnail to open the template in 'Compose' mode 
 Select the 
 Email Camaign Name from drop down list 
 Select subject 
 of the campaign 
 Modify the 
 template by changing or adding text, image, button, separator and social 
 icons. All features are same as discussed under basic template section. 
 Click on 
 the camera icon to open 'Image Cropper' 
 Click on 
 'Upload new image' button 
 Click 'Open'. 
 Crop image 
 as per desired dimension and click 'Submit' 
 New text 
 field can be added by dragging and dropping the text component 
 New image 
 can be added by dragging and dropping the image component 
 Click 'Browse' 
 to upload the image file. 
 New button 
 can be added by dragging and dropping the button component. 
 Similarly, 
 separator, social icons and html tags can be added. 
 After tagging 
 recipients and scheduling, submit and save the template. 
 Tutorial: Creating Email Campaign 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

 Get

 Note: Farvision

 Component Name : 
 FacebookConfigurationComponent 
 Services : 
 FacebookAdvertConfigurationService 
 Usage: 
 Make sure we have 
 access to the Facebook Javascript SDK. To be able to use Facebook javascript 
 SDK, use the below link in your ‘index.html ‘ page. 
 <scriptsrc="//connect.facebook.net/en_US/sdk.js"></script> 
 Get 
 Permanent Access token: 
 To be able to get permanent access token/long lived 
 token (defined in section 1), we call FacebookAdvertConfigurations API 
 action from our UI, which requires short lived token. To be able to get 
 short lived token, the target user must login to Facebook. Therefore the 
 user is prompted to login to Facebook. After login, the long lived token 
 is generated and all associated pages will be fetched and displayed in 
 the UI. User can get associated LeadGen forms by clicking on the respective 
 links in the page.

 Q. 
 How to determine 
 which fields are mandatory when importing leads or opportunities from 
 an excel sheet?

 information can be found in the ‘info’ sheet of the import file, where 
 the mandatory fields are listed. 
 Q. How 
 to control the visibility or masking of mobile numbers in SFA? 
 Answer : This can be done in ‘Setup’ by navigating 
 to the following path: Setup> Sales Team> Role. 
 Q. 
 How can the 
 lead status be tracked if a lead is converted to an Opportunity? 
 Answer : 
 The lead status can be tracked from 
 the Opportunity entry as the same lead is converted to an Opportunity.

title: Media Center Module
text:
Media Center Module 
 Media Center 
 Module

 is the Media Center Module?

 Prerequisites

 process to create a Release Order (RO)

 Media 
 Center – Release Order User Guide 
 1. 
 What is the Media Center Module? 
 The Media Center module in Farvision 
 ERP is used to create and manage Release Orders (ROs) . 
It is integrated with: 
 Sales 
 Force Automation (SFA) 
 Finance 
 Material 
 Management 
 Note: Invoice 
 booking against a Release Order (RO) 
 shall be executed through the Non-Store 
 Purchase entry within the Material 
 module , with mandatory tagging 
 of the corresponding Release Order (RO). 
 2. 
 Business Purpose / Why It Is Used 
 The Release 
 Order functionality helps organizations: 
 Manage campaign-based 
 purchases 
 Create structured 
 media procurement records 
 Track budget 
 consumption (when project budgets exist) 
 Sync accounts 
 & campaign details with SFA 
 Ensure all 
 media expenses go through a controlled workflow 
 3. 
 Prerequisites / Dependencies 
 Before creating 
 an RO or Release Order, the following must exist: 
 Business 
 Unit 
 Campaign 
 created in SFA 
 Account 
 Head & Parent Account Head mapped in 
 SFA 
 Budget 
 created at the Business 
 Unit level (optional but recommended) 
 4. Step-by-Step Process 
 to Create a Release Order 
 Step 
 1: Open Release Order Page 
 Go to: Media 
 Center > Release Order 
 Mandatory fields like are highlighted in Red 
 in the system. 
 Step 
 2: Select Business Unit 
 Once the Business Unit is selected: 
 the Financial Year, Document Type, Document Date are 
 automatically fetched . 
 Step 
 3: Account Head Auto-Fetch 
 The system automatically fetches: Account Head, Parent Account Head 
 from the Finance 
 Module . 
 Step 4: Add Item Info 
 Go to Item Info tab 
 Click Add 
 New Row 
 Step 
 5: Fill Item Info 
 You must complete: A. Information Section B. Others 
 Section C. Dimension Section 
 A. Information 
 Section 
 Select 
 Campaign Name (the campaign must be pre-created in 
 SFA) & click Next 
 B. Others 
 Section 
 Enter 
 RO Amount 
 & click Next 
 C. Dimension 
 Section 
 Select 
 Contractor 
 If 
 a project budget exists under the Business Unit, 
 it appears automatically in the Budget 
 Section 
 Click Finish 
 after filling all details. 
 Step 
 6: Review Billing Terms 
 Before submitting the Release Order or RO: 
 Open Billing 
 Term 
 Verify 
 billing details carefully 
 Step 
 7: Submit the Release Order 
 Once verified, click Submit . 
 Step 
 8: View the Print Preview 
 Go to Print, select print format of the RO, and click 
 Print . 
 5. 
 End-to-End Workflow 
 SFA 
 > Media Center > Material Module > Budget Tracking (Finance) 
 Campaign 
 created in SFA 
 Release 
 Order created in Media Center 
 RO appears 
 as Non-Store Purchase in Material Module 
 Budget auto-check 
 happens based on Project/Business Unit 
 6. Field Reference Table 
 Field 
 Description 
 Business Unit 
 Determines financial year, document 
 type, and date 
 Account Head 
 Pulled from Finance Module 
 Parent Account Head 
 Pulled from Finance Module 
 Campaign Name 
 Selected from SFA-created campaigns 
 RO Amount 
 Enter the release order value 
 Contractor 
 Vendor/Contractor tied to dimensions 
 Budget Section 
 Auto-fetched if project budget exists 
 7. 
 Best Practices 
 Always create 
 campaign in SFA before making RO 
 Double-check 
 Billing Terms before submission 
 Ensure Business Unit selection 
 is correct 
 Keep Account and Parent Account Head 
 properly maintained in Finance Module 
 .
